newsitem.title: USA: Northern States unit completes offering.
newsitem.headline: Northern States unit completes offering.

text.p: NRG Energy Inc, a wholly owned subsidiary of Northern States Power Co, said Tuesday it completed an offering of $250 million in 7-1/2 percent senior notes due 2007.
The 10-year note offering was managed by Salomon Brothers Inc and co-managed by ABN AMRO and Chase Securities. It was priced at 99.76, to yield 7.534 percent.
The company said most of the proceeds will be used to pay down a bridge loan provided by Salomon Brothers related to an cquisition. The balance will be used for general corporate purposes.
The notes have not been registered under the Securities Act of 1933 and may not be offered or sold in the United States without registration or an exemption, NRG said.
NRG is an independent power producer.
